step_by_step_reasoning: 1. Identify system components from visual input and transcript: F1 Car telemetry (UserCompanyEdge), Biggin Hill Data Center (ThirdParty), AWS API Gateway (ApiGateway), AWS Lambda (Lambda), Amazon DynamoDB (DynamoDB), Amazon S3 (S3), Amazon SageMaker (SageMaker), Broadcast Center (ThirdParty), and F1 Broadcast Feed (ThirdParty). 2. Trace data flow: Telemetry from the F1 car is sent to Biggin Hill Data Center, routed into AWS via API Gateway, processed and synchronized by Lambda, stored across DynamoDB and S3, fed into SageMaker machine learning models (on-track and pit lane) for real-time race predictions, sent to the Broadcast Center, and ultimately displayed on the F1 Broadcast Feed.

graph.name: Formula 1 Pit Strategy Battle Insights Architecture
graph.notes: Formula 1 processes telemetry and timing data on AWS using Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, and SageMaker machine learning models to generate real-time race strategy insights for live broadcast feeds.

nodes.name: F1 Car
nodes.notes: Collects telemetry and timing transponder data directly from the race car on track.

nodes.name: Biggin Hill Data Center
nodes.notes: F1 data center located in Biggin Hill receiving incoming track telemetry.

nodes.name: API Gateway
nodes.notes: Extracts and routes incoming telemetry data into the AWS cloud machine learning pipeline.

nodes.name: Lambda
nodes.notes: Processes and synchronizes timing transponder timestamps with car telemetry.

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Stores application data used for ML training and model evaluation.

nodes.name: SageMaker
nodes.notes: Trains and deploys ML models (on-track and pit lane models) for real-time pit strategy predictions.

nodes.name: Broadcast Center
nodes.notes: Receives ML insight graphics and race strategy predictions at the track.

nodes.name: F1 Broadcast Feed
nodes.notes: Pushes race insight graphics onto the live TV broadcast feed.

edges.notes: Car telemetry and timing transponder data sent to Biggin Hill.
Data extracted from Biggin Hill into AWS API Gateway.
Lambda writes synchronized timing data into DynamoDB.
Lambda stores processed application data into S3.
Real-time synchronized timing data supplied from DynamoDB to SageMaker.
Application data from S3 fed into SageMaker for model inference and training.
SageMaker sends real-time strategy predictions to the Broadcast Center.
Broadcast Center pushes insights onto the live F1 Broadcast Feed.
